{{Use dmy dates|date=July 2022}}

'''Dmitry Borisovich Kolker''' ({{langx|ru|link=no|Дмитрий Борисович Колкер}}; 7 June 1968 – 2 July 2022) was a Russian physicist, [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]], member of the [[Institute of Laser Physics]], head of the Laboratory of [[Quantum optics|Quantum Optical Technologies]] of [[Novosibirsk State University]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://meduza.io/news/2022/07/03/umer-uchenyy-dmitriy-kolker-arestovannyy-po-delu-o-gosizmene |title=Умер ученый Дмитрий Колкер, арестованный три дня назад по делу о госизмене. Его отправили в СИЗО с четвертой стадией рака |publisher=[[Meduza (website)|Meduza]] |date=3 July 2022 |access-date=4 July 2022 |language=ru}}</ref><ref name="multiple">{{Cite web |date=2022-07-03 |title=Умер арестованный по делу о госизмене больной раком ученый Дмитрий Колкер |url=https://www.vedomosti.ru/society/news/2022/07/03/929585-umer-kolker/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=Ведомости |language=ru}}</ref><ref name="NGS">{{Cite web |date=2022-07-01 |title=Игра на органе и квантовая оптика: чем занимался арестованный за госизмену Дмитрий Колкер |url=https://ngs.ru/text/science/2022/07/01/71454914/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=НГС.ру - новости Новосибирска |language=ru}}</ref>

On 30 June 2022, Kolker was arrested on suspicion of passing information to China. He was in hospital suffering from advanced [[pancreatic cancer]] when he was arrested. He was flown to Moscow and put into prison where he died shortly afterwards.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Trevelyan |first1=Mark |title=Russian laser scientist dies two days after arrest for state treason |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-scientist-dies-two-days-after-arrest-state-treason-lawyer-2022-07-03/ |access-date=4 July 2022 |date=3 July 2022 |work=Reuters}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.thetimes.com/world/asia/article/terminally-ill-russian-physicist-dmitry-kolker-dies-days-after-arrest-f832nsxff | title=Terminally ill Russian physicist Dmitry Kolker dies days after arrest | last1=Bennetts | first1=Marc |work=[[The Times]] |access-date=9 July 2022 |date=4 July 2022 }}</ref>

==Biography==
Kolker was born in 1968. In 1995 he graduated from the Faculty of Physics and Technology of the [[Novosibirsk State Technical University|Novosibirsk Electrotechnical Institute]] (NETI, now Novosibirsk State Technical University), Department of Laser Systems. 
The scientist headed the Laboratory of Quantum Optical Technologies at the Institute of Laser Physics and Novosibirsk State University, and he was also a professor at the Department of Laser Systems at the Novosibirsk State Technical University.<ref name="NGS" />
As an academic, his publications are listed at the [[Russian Science Citation Index]] numbered at 143, and at 115 according to [[Scopus]], with an [[h-index]] of 17.<ref name="NGS" />

Kolker was also a classical musician. 
According to his [[VK (service)|VK]] account, he graduated from the Novosibirsk College of Music.<ref name="NGS" />
Several photos with the organ were published on his page. Together with his wife Natalia, he performed at the Novosibirsk Philharmonic.<ref name="NGS" /><ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sT9ixZbIvdo |title=Дмитрий Колкер. Знакомство с органом |date=2017-01-21 |last=Eureka Project |access-date=2024-05-22 |via=YouTube}}</ref>

===Suspicion of state treason, arrest and death===
On 30 June 2022, the Soviet District Court of Novosibirsk arrested Kolker on suspicion of [[treason|state treason]]. Kolker's son Maxim said that his father was detained by the FSB in the hospital, where he was hospitalized due to deteriorating health against the backdrop of a severe stage of cancer. According to TASS, he was taken by plane to Moscow and placed in the Lefortovo pre-trial detention center.<ref name="multiple" /> A few days before his arrest, another Novosibirsk scientist [[Anatoly Maslov]] was also arrested on suspicion of state treason.<ref>{{Cite web |title=За госизмену арестован еще один ученый Академгородка Анатолий Маслов |url=https://poisknews.ru/news/za-gosizmenu-arestovan-eshhe-odin-uchenyj-akademgorodka-anatolij-maslov/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=poisknews.ru |language=ru-RU}}</ref>

According to his relatives, the scientist gave lectures to students in China, the content of which was checked by the [[Federal Security Service|FSB]]. He was suspected of passing information to that country.<ref name="multiple" />

On 2 July 2022 at 2:40&nbsp;a.m. local time, he died in Moscow Hospital No. 29.<ref name="multiple" />

His body was cremated at [[Novosibirsk Crematorium]] on 19 July 2022. The farewell ceremony was attended by about 80 people.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-07-19 |title=«Эти 2 недели меня не покидает один вопрос». Репортаж с похорон ученого Дмитрия Колкера, обвиненного в госизмене |url=https://ngs.ru/text/gorod/2022/07/19/71500652/ |access-date=2024-05-22 |website=НГС.ру - новости Новосибирска |language=ru}}</ref>
